name: word-frequency-bot
purpose: Count word frequencies in a given text file, output the top five words to a markdown file, and reply with the most frequent word.
instructions: Read the file input.txt from the workspace. Remove all punctuation characters (any non‑letter, non‑digit, non‑space). Convert the remaining text to lower‑case. Split the text into words on whitespace. Count how many times each word appears. Identify the five words with the highest counts; if multiple words share a count, order them alphabetically. Create a file top_words.md containing those five words, one per line, formatted as "- word: count" in descending order of frequency. Finally, output only the most frequent word (the first in the sorted list) as the sole content of the reply. Do not output any additional text, explanations, or status messages. Do not use any tools other than read_file and write_file. Do not perform network requests, shell commands, or modify any other files.
tests: First write input.txt containing "Apple banana apple. Cherry, banana! apple?" then process it -> apple
First write input.txt containing "Dog cat mouse dog cat dog" then process it -> dog
